Missouri Congressional Map Thrown into Chaos by Conflicting Court Rulings

Missouri's congressional map is in disarray following contradictory rulings from state courts. The Missouri Supreme Court and a lower circuit court issued conflicting decisions regarding the state's redistricting plan. These dissonant rulings have created uncertainty about which map will ultimately be used for upcoming elections, leaving the state's electoral boundaries in flux. The situation has led to a chaotic electoral landscape as the state navigates the legal challenges to its congressional map.
